verdict.rationale: Deel's marketing and API docs explicitly state it runs payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers across 150+ countries from one unified platform, with API endpoints to create contractor contracts and manage payroll data. Community evidence raises trust/service-quality concerns but does not concretely contradict the core capability of paying both W-2 employees and contractors from one system. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of actual W-2 employee payroll runs alongside contractor payments, and more detail on US-specific W-2 handling beyond marketing copy.
